🚀 We are hiring! Senior Full Stack / Backend Developer (C# / .NET / React) 
 Want to build software that runs real-world industrial operations and see your work deployed live on open-pit mine sites? Our team in Bucharest is looking for a Senior Full Stack or strong Backend Developer to help build and evolve a large-scale distributed platform powering fleet and equipment workflows in mining!
 If you care about ownership, clean architecture, and building systems with real-world physical impact, let's connect!
 What you will do: 
 Backend Engineering: Design and build robust services using C# and .NET in a scalable microservices and event-driven architecture.
 Frontend Excellence: Build modern, high-performance React applications using component libraries (MUI, Mantine, or shadcn) and state management tools.
 End-to-End Ownership: Own features completely from architectural design through to production deployment in mission-critical environments.
 Domain Collaboration: Partner closely with operational experts to translate complex industrial problems into reliable, high-performance software.
 What you need to bring: 
Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET in microservices/event-driven systems.
Solid SQL skills, experience with SQL Server , and proficiency with ORMs like Entity Framework.
Proven frontend expertise in React , modern component libraries, and state management.
Strong focus on clean architecture, API design, data modeling, and code maintainability.
B2 Upper-Intermediate English communication skills.
 (Bonus points for Docker/K8s exposure, C++ integration experience, or background in industrial/mining software!) 
 Why Luxoft? 
 Real-World Impact: Build software that directly powers heavy machinery and operational teams on live mine sites.
 Attractive Package: Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
 Growth & Culture: Continuous professional development, training, and a collaborative international team environment.
 📍 Location: Bucharest, Romania
